name: Template Time
description: The `template` time platform allows you to create a real time clock whose value is computed by a [lambda](https://esphome.io/automations/templates#config-lambda). A common use is deriving a new time source by applying an offset to an already-synchronized time source.

config_entries.label: Lambda
config_entries.description: Lambda that returns the current time as a UNIX timestamp (an integer number of seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC). It is evaluated every time this time source's current time is read, for example by calling `.now()` on it in a lambda. Return `{}` if a value isn't currently available.

config_entries.label: Update Interval
config_entries.description: How often to synchronize the device time from the source. Defaults to `15min`.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Specify the ID of the time for use in lambdas.

config_entries.label: Timezone
config_entries.description: Manually tell ESPHome what time zone to use with [this format](https://www.gnu.org/software/libc/manual/html_node/TZ-Variable.html) (warning: the format is quite complicated, see [examples](https://github.com/nayarsystems/posix_tz_db/blob/master/zones.csv)) or the simpler [TZ database name](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones) in the form `<Region>/<City>`. ESPHome tries to automatically infer the time zone string based on the time zone of the computer that is running ESPHome, but this might not always be accurate. Not available on nRF52 platforms. An empty timezone (the empty string, `""`) will mean no timezone handling will be compiled in, so the device will operate strictly on UTC.
